content: The {{variable.Object_Event}} object stores information about your {{variable.Object_Event}} , including what, where, and when. It’s also the place where you can find links to everything else that pertains to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Create an Event Go to the Events tab. Click {{variable.button_new}} . Fill in the fields in the sections below. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Information {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} (required) {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Campaign}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TimeZone}} (required) {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerContact}} - This field, or the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerAccount}} field, will show who organized the Event under the title on the Event webpage. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerAccount}} - This field will be overwritten by the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerContact}} field if both fields are populated. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventSettings}} – Click here for more information about {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} - Click here for more information about {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Category}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} - Click here for more information about the different user interfaces. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Publish}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CustomCSSURL}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ShowInformation}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UseGradient}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_FormPostRegistra}} - Click here for more information about {{variable.Object_Form}} s. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PostEventQuestio}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VisibilityContro}} - Click here for more information about visibility control. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CancelBeforeDate}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CancelBeforeTime}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} Why can’t I see the Organizer(Contact) field on the Event Webpage? The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerContact}} or {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OrganizerAccount}} field will only be visible on the Event webpage when the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} is set to Simple or Tabbed. Budget & Expense Summaries Click here for information about the Budget & Expense object. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AudioVisuaBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AudioVisuExpense}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CateringBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CateringExpenses}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContingencBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContingenExpense}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_DecorBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_DecorExpenses}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EntertainBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EntertainExpense}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MarketingBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MarketingExpense}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MktgSocialBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MktgSocialExpens}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OtherBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OtherExpenses}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PlanOrganiBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ProdStaffExpense}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SiteRentalBudget}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SiteRentalExpens}} Additional Functionality Publish the {{variable.Object_Event}} : If the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Publish}} (conference360__Visible__c) field is set to “True” or checked, then the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be viewable via the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} and on all public Event Groups and {{variable.Object_Event}} lists. If the field is unchecked, the {{variable.Object_Event}} can only be viewed by clicking the Preview button. {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} Field: The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} field shows the internal status of the {{variable.Object_Event}} and is used by Event Admins. For example, an Admin might change the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} to “Draft” to let other Admins know that they are updating the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The values “Draft,” “Active,” “Canceled”, and “Completed” do not reflect if the {{variable.Object_Event}} has been published. The {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} is set to “Active” by default when the {{variable.Object_Event}} is created. Once the {{variable.Object_Event}} record exists, an Admin must manually change the field to “Completed” or “Canceled” or use the Blackthorn | Events Status Update scheduled job to update the field’s value. Records Related to an Event: The maximum number of related records supported per {{variable.Object_Event}} is 4000. However, we caution that {{variable.Object_Event}} s with over 2000 related records may experience some sluggishness.
